mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, song_id, idempotency_key, started_at, ended_at, visible_seconds, counted_seconds, created_at FROM score_views WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} FOR SHARE
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM songs WHERE id = #{songId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO score_views (user_id, song_id, idempotency_key, started_at, ended_at, visible_seconds, counted_seconds) VALUES (#{userId}, #{songId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{visibleSeconds}, #{countedSeconds})
